subject.title: chore(deps): bump the android-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates

question: Should the Android release train adopt Kotlin 2.4.10 now, including its Compose stability-inference correction, after refreshing the branch and Android gates against current main?
rationale: Automated builds establish compatibility at compile and test time, but they cannot decide whether the Android release train should accept the upstream compiler behavior change or defer it for broader device observation.

options.title: Adopt after refresh
options.body: Update the branch to current main, rerun the Android gates, and merge if the Android owner accepts the compiler behavior change.

options.title: Defer the compiler update
options.body: Close or postpone this bump until the next Android dependency window if broader device or performance observation is preferred.

recommendation.title: Adopt after refresh
recommendation.body: Update the branch to current main, rerun the Android gates, and merge if the Android owner accepts the compiler behavior change.
